visual.scope: Six authored canvas cases. Real OCR, privacy pipeline, Qwen and DOM-grounded execution. One cold client then warm client runs. Same running server. No independent population or held-out claim.

pii.scope: Case/type micro scores, not entity/span accuracy

redaction.scope: Black-mask overlap with authored glyphs and approximate face rectangles; mixed annotations, not population precision

resources.scope: Browser process tree. Baseline renders same pages; active includes extension popup and local inference. Difference of observed peaks is NOT isolated extension allocation. CPU is ps process-lifetime average; GPU process RSS is NOT VRAM.

judge.scope: Cold client models each run; already-running local Qwen. Success-only latency, all attempts in completion denominator. Three runs do not establish tail latency.
